sites.name: Peak near Cabeus B
sites.note: Artemis candidate region (representative point PCB03). Coordinates verified against Wueller et al. 2026, Table A1. The point lies 6.4 degrees from the pole, outside NASA's 6 degree limit, and so do all five of the paper's sites in this region.
sites.source: Wueller et al. 2026, JGR Planets, doi:10.1029/2025JE009434, Table A1 (checked against the paper and its Zenodo data set, 14 Nov 2026)

sites.note: Artemis candidate region (representative point MMP06). Coordinates verified against Wueller et al. 2026, Table A1. The paper chose this point for access to a permanent shadow colder than 110 K, not for sunlight: it sits in a hollow and gets 14% average sunlight.
sites.source: Wueller et al. 2026, JGR Planets, doi:10.1029/2025JE009434, Table A1 (checked against the paper and its Zenodo data set, 14 Nov 2026)

sites.note: Artemis candidate region (representative point NR208). Coordinates verified against Wueller et al. 2026, Table A1. The point lies 6.1 degrees from the pole, just outside NASA's 6 degree limit, in a local hollow; three of the paper's other sites in this region (NR201, NR202, NR2_K2023) are inside the limit.
